# Bundled three.js modules

This directory contains three.js r187 and the OrbitControls, GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils, and SkeletonUtils addons used by the local 3D preview. The application resolves these modules through the import map in `web/index.html` and does not require a public CDN.

Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

The original MIT license and source headers are preserved; see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
